description: Produce a clean, client-facing markdown rate comparison report a loan officer can share with a buyer. Pass either a saved scenario_id, or an inline client_name + comparison result (from get_financing_decision/compare_products).

advisor_name.description: Optional advisor/company name for the report header

client_name.description: Client label, if not using scenario_id

result.description: The comparison result to format, if not using scenario_id

scenario_id.description: Optional: a saved scenario id to build the report from

name: generate_client_report

outputSchema.description: A client-ready rate comparison rendered locally by the MCP server. Nothing is persisted and no link is created.

markdown.description: The full report: heading, advisor byline, scenario line, a ranked offer table of up to five lenders, and a not-an-offer-of-credit footer.
